meaning: Every stronger listed conclusion requires a new distinguishing observation; missing sufficient statistics are not treated as a negative result.

rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: mean bias as the unique mediator of loss
rows.missing_observation: an intervention independently changing mean, variance, and coordinate/time structure while preserving the others

rows.deducible_now: FP32 addition-order source plus nonzero profile means over observed declared units
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: fresh population generality or causal sufficiency for loss
rows.missing_observation: new independently sampled states and a matched training intervention changing only addition order

rows.deducible_now: saved-score/statistic inconsistency causes row-mass defect on every retained row; a 1024-step declared trajectory confirms the restoration reaches gradient/write and produces trajectory non-identity
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: natural population mean update bias or material loss consequence
rows.missing_observation: independent state-bank sampling with a predeclared loss endpoint and consistent-saved-state restoration propagated through gradient and parameter write

rows.deducible_now: one delayed-BF16-materialization contributor and its transport path
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: one unique source for the whole attention region
rows.missing_observation: separate interventions for remaining upstream-logit and residual-stream contributors

rows.deducible_now: conditional arithmetic and output-rounding effects in selected comparisons
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: exact main effects and interaction on common coordinates
rows.missing_observation: candidate, arithmetic-only, cast-only, and joint output vectors on identical operands

rows.deducible_now: candidate/reference derivative evaluation differs and optimizer response has an even component
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: which sigmoid, expression-order, or final-cast choice creates the natural residual
rows.missing_observation: common operands and componentwise intermediate outputs

rows.deducible_now: same-input implementation difference and optimizer-state dependence
rows.not_deducible_from_retained_data: low-level arithmetic source or moments separately from step counter
rows.missing_observation: same-operands materialization variants and a fixed-step-counter optimizer-state comparison
